title: suggestion-history
description: CLI-owned cross-run suggestion history. Stored at ~/.self-improve-reports/blazor-architect/suggestion-history.json. Append-only records of user decisions for suggestion_key-based dedup weighting and dismissal penalty application. Never committed to source control — local machine only.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the history file itself.

entries.description: Append-only ordered list of user decision records. Each record corresponds to one user action on a suggestion_key in a given run.

history_entry.description: One append-only decision record. Never mutated after append.

suggestion_key.description: Deterministic identity key for the suggestion. Derived from normalized intent + target surface + proposed change shape. See docs/self-improve-generation.md for key derivation rules.

action.description: 'accepted': user queued and shipped. 'dismissed': user dismissed with optional cooldown. 'never_again': user permanently suppressed this suggestion key.

run_id.description: Run ID of the run in which this decision was made.

decided_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the decision was recorded.

dismissed_reason.description: Optional free-text reason provided by the user at dismissal time.

specialist.description: Specialist lane that surfaced the finding in the referenced run.

category.description: Category of the finding at the time of decision. Informational only; weighting uses suggestion_key, not category.
